"""Frozen full-map comparison; verification mode never changes product limits."""
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
source, case_json, mode, output = sys.argv[1:]
sys.path.insert(0,source)
from bj import ev, joint_split
from bj import _enumeration
from bj.common_shoe import decide, reference_counts
from bj.core import Rules
case=json.loads(case_json)
rules=Rules(max_hands=2,resplit_aces=False,hit_split_aces=False,
            s17=case['s17'],das=case['das'])
hand=(case['pair'],case['pair'])
counts=tuple(case['counts'])
token=None
class VerificationBudget:
    """Count original arithmetic entries without weakening installed scope()."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.counts={}
        self.attempted=0
    def enter(self,family):
        self.attempted+=1
        if self.attempted>500000:
            raise RuntimeError('separate original-arithmetic verification cap exceeded')
        self.counts[family]=self.counts.get(family,0)+1
    def snapshot(self):
        return {'verification_only':True,'limit':500000,'states':sum(self.counts.values()),
                'attempted_states':self.attempted,'state_counts':dict(sorted(self.counts.items()))}
start=time.perf_counter()
try:
    if mode=='original-verification':
        budget=VerificationBudget()
        token=_enumeration._active.set(budget)
        _,values,_=ev.best_action(hand,case['up'],shoe=counts,rules=rules,
                                 can_double=True,can_split=False)
        split=joint_split.joint_split_value(case['pair'],case['up'],reference_counts(counts),
                  double_after_split=rules.das,stand_soft_17=rules.s17,max_states=500000)
        values['P']=split.value
        ordered=sorted(values.items(),key=lambda row:row[1],reverse=True)
        action=ordered[0][0]
        margin=ordered[0][1]-ordered[1][1]
        work=budget.snapshot()
    else:
        action,values,margin,work=decide(hand,case['up'],counts,rules,max_states=100000)
    record={'status':'complete','action':action,'values_hex':{k:v.hex() for k,v in values.items()},
            'margin_hex':margin.hex(),'work':work}
except Exception as exc:
    record={'status':'refused','type':type(exc).__name__,'reason':str(exc),
            'work':getattr(exc,'work',None)}
finally:
    if token is not None:
        _enumeration._active.reset(token)
record.update(case=case,mode=mode,elapsed_call_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start,
              product_limit_unchanged=_enumeration.MAX_STATES==100000,
              verification_bound_only=mode=='original-verification')
record['source_sha256']={str(p.relative_to(source)).replace('\\','/'):
   hashlib.sha256(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').replace('\r\n','\n').encode()).hexdigest()
   for p in [Path(source,'bj/joint_split.py'),Path(source,'bj/common_shoe.py'),
             Path(source,'bj/ev.py'),Path(source,'bj/_enumeration.py')]}
with Path(output).open('x',encoding='utf-8') as stream:
    json.dump(record,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ('source_sha256','case')}))
